$comment: The demo as an eval target: six screens of apps/demo, each briefed as a
product would brief it. The scorer compares the generation against the
real screen, so the brief says what the screen must do and never which
`screen` is the real screen's directory, relative to apps/demo/src/screens.
`patterns` are the pattern contracts the screen implements.
`expects.components` is the real screen's IonBase components that have a
contract. It is written by `node prompts/demo-screens.mjs --write`, and
build-packs fails if it no longer matches the screen. Never edit it by hand.
Data comes from `declare`d functions in each brief, so a generation
compiles on its own, with no fixture code.
